flow.name: products-get-flow
flow.doc:description: A catalog page: local price or the last price of the preferred provider. Never quotes live

http:request.http:query-params: #[output application/java --- { page: attributes.queryParams.page default 1, size: attributes.queryParams.size default 20 }]

choice.doc:description: An empty page needs no second call

otherwise.doc:description: Batch call with the providers of the page items

http:request.doc:description: The same items with their providers and last prices (one call)

ee:transform.doc:description: Products with their catalog price, sorted by SKU

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toProduct from modules::orders output application/json --- (payload map toProduct($)) orderBy ((p) -> p.sku)

flow.name: orders-list-flow
flow.doc:description: Orders by status and from a date: the query goes to sapi-oracle-core

http:request.doc:description: Lists the ERP orders with the same filters

flow.name: orders-register-flow
flow.doc:description: Validates the customer and registers the order as RECEIVED in less than 1 s; the cycle confirms it later

set-variable.doc:description: Keeps the request: each HTTP call replaces the payload

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Register order, orderId: ' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' customerId: ' ++ vars.newOrder.customerId ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the registration

choice.doc:description: An unknown customer is a validation error

http:request.doc:description: Registers header and lines in the ERP; the order is born RECEIVED
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { orderId: vars.orderId, customerId: vars.newOrder.customerId, currency: p('currency'), lines: vars.newOrder.lines }]

choice.doc:description: The ERP rejects unknown or repeated items with 400

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- payload.message default 'The order lines are not valid']

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId default vars.orderId, status: payload.status default "RECEIVED", createdAt: payload.createdAt }

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Register order, orderId: ' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the end of the registration
